column1: # Doc-comment version references that name a version with no tag and no CHANGELOG entry.
# RATCHET BASELINE. A version listed here is grandfathered; anything NEW fails the gate.
# Burn this down (CIRISPersist#599) -- do not add to it.
# v30.12.0 burndown: 10 versions / 170 references retired. What is left is NOT
# the same kind of thing the retired rows were, so the rows are grouped by WHY
# they are still here. Only ONE group is a persist phantom, and it names work
# that is still unshipped, so there is no real version to name instead.
# The classification, so the next pass does not re-derive it:
#   FALSE POSITIVE  another project's version. `doc_version_refs.py`'s NAMED_CRATE
#                   guard reads only the text BEFORE the version ON THE SAME LINE,
#                   so a citation whose project name wrapped to the previous line
#                   ("...matching CIRISAgent\n//! v2.8.13's `wa_cert`") is invisible
#                   to it, as is any project not in its alternation (CIRISEdge,
#                   CIRISConformance, FSD-NNN). These doc comments are CORRECT and
#                   unambiguous to a reader; rewording them to satisfy a line-local
#                   regex would be gaming the gate, not improving the docs. The fix
#                   is in the GUARD -- widen the project list and let it see the
#                   enclosing doc block -- not in `src/`.
#   TAG-ONLY        a real persist release with a git tag and no CHANGELOG entry.
#                   The gate reads CHANGELOG only, deliberately: consulting `git tag`
#                   as well made it ENVIRONMENT-DEPENDENT -- green on a full local
#                   clone, RED in CI's shallow checkout. The reference is TRUE; the
#                   debt is the missing entry. Fix = backfill the CHANGELOG, then
#                   delete the row.
#   PLANNED         a persist version that was named for work which was never cut,
#                   and the work is STILL unshipped. There is no honest version to
#                   substitute; naming a real one would assert something false.
# version
# ── FALSE POSITIVE: other CIRIS projects ───────────────────────────────────────
# ── TAG-ONLY: real release, CHANGELOG entry missing ────────────────────────────

column3: TAG EXISTS, no CHANGELOG entry -- iOS Secure-Enclave signer backoff + boot-time audit-chain self-verification, all in `ffi/pyo3.rs`. Backfill the entry, then delete this row
